E2.label: E2_DISPOSITION
E2.meaning: Ordinary legacy transfers do not maintain contribution ancestry or prequoted credit. The weighted DETF counterexample shows two histories with identical balance observations and different required credits. An immutable permissionless history verifier was not established and is UNPROVEN, not a speculative PASS. Frozen allowances, payer signatures, mutable roots and mandatory wrappers are rejected constraints, not available fixes.
